record.title: FICC/GSD sponsored participation
record.sub: Participate through an account or member
kv: Rule 3A permits a relationship between approved Sponsoring Member and person accepted by FICC as its Sponsored Member. DTCC states the entry conditions as approved-jurisdiction legal entity plus an available sponsor.
A qualified legal entity seeks GSD access through a Sponsoring Member rather than direct netting membership.
legal entity in FICC-approved jurisdiction; eligible GSD Netting Member applying as Sponsoring Member
Sponsoring applicant meets Rule 3A/current standards and is approved. FICC accepts entity as that sponsor's Sponsored Member. Parties comply with current rules, guaranty, and service documents.
Sponsored access is separate from direct Netting Membership; a service page does not replace GSD Rules.

scope_note: A browsing entity/group does not inherit another legal entity’s permissions.
